just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Bb4 and dwells most on C in Gereyli. The line peaks at F5 (688.2 Hz) at 3:13.7. It closes on C5, not the tonic (Bb4 → Bb4 → C5 → Bb4 → Bb4 → C5).
